title: Translator & Interpreter (Re-advertisement - for internal and external candidates), Grade 17
description: Jordan Translator & Interpreter (Re-advertisement - for internal and external candidates), Grade 17 Organization UN Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees in the Near East Posted 8 Oct 2026 Closing date 21 Oct 2026 Org. Setting and Reporting UNRWA is a United Nations agency established by the General Assembly in 1949 and is mandated to provide assistance and protection to a population of some 5.8 million registered Palestine refugees. Its mission is to help Palestine refugees in Jordan, Lebanon, Syria, West Bank and the Gaza Strip to achieve their full potential in human development, pending a just solution to their plight. UNRWA's services encompass education, health care, relief and social services, camp infrastructure and improvement, microfinance, and emergency assistance. UNRWA is the largest UN operation in the Middle East with more than 30,000 staff. UNRWA is funded almost entirely by voluntary contributions. If you are looking for a rewarding opportunity to make a tangible difference for one of the most vulnerable communities in the world, UNRWA would like to hear from you. Supervisor: The incumbent reports to the Director of Communications. Responsibilities Translates documents, reports, and website content from English into Arabic and vice versa for internal or external use, ensuring accuracy and precision. Acts as interpreter at internal and external meetings, press briefings and other official occasions as required. Assists the Head of Creative Digital Multimedia Communications with editing of UNRWA's official Arab language materials; collaborates with the Communications Division's Arabic desk in these tasks. Edits and proofreads agency-wide documents, as required, including sensitive documents, pertaining to the work of the Executive Office and from other departments such as the Department of Legal Affairs, Department of Human Resources, Ethics Office, Office of the Ombudsman, Protection and Neutrality unit; and assists such departments in overseeing the final production of their key documents, bulletins and other issuances. Performs other duties as may be assigned by the Director of Communications, including, where required, in support of other offices or departments in the Agency. Competencies UN Core Values of Integrity, Professionalism and Respect for Diversity, and Core Competencies of Communication, Working with People and Drive for Results apply by default. Applying Technical Expertise Analyzing Planning and Organizing Delivering Results Demonstrating Self-Awareness Ability to work independently or in a team. Tactful and well-developed political awareness. Knowledge and experience of using computer with proficiency in word processing in English and Arabic. Education Advanced university degree (Master's or equivalent) from an accredited educational institution in English, translation and interpretation or a related field.
